title: Mercy
lyrics_original: I will kneel in the dust
At the foot of the cross,
It is gone, it has passed.
We will lift up the cup
And the bread we will break,
But You took on our shame
And nailed it to the cross.
May I never lose the wonder,
Oh, the wonder of Your mercy.
May I never lose the wonder,
Oh, the wonder of Your mercy.
I will kneel in the dust
At the foot of the cross,

bible_verses.english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
but God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us, even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ (by grace you have been saved),

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the incredible price You paid for me on the cross. Your precious blood has covered my past, washed away my guilt, and granted me a mercy I could never earn. I come to You today with a humble heart, marveling at how deep and endless Your love is. Help me to walk in the freedom of Your salvation and to sing Your praise forever. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: At the foot of the cross, we find the place where our deepest debt was fully paid and judgment was replaced with grace. Jesus bore the weight of our sin so that we could be safely hidden in His righteousness, covered by His unending love. When we look at His sacrifice, our hearts cannot help but overflow with gratitude for a mercy as boundless as the sea. Today, take a quiet moment to rest in His presence, leave your burdens behind, and praise Him for His everlasting grace.
